canonicalFacts.rule: Spelling and date are immutable unless the user explicitly changes them.

editorialReferenceOnly: feature teaser headings/copy visible in the master
visualMasterTextSafety.rule: Generated/reference copy is not autobiographical truth by itself. Personal/factual guest-facing copy remains native/editable and grounded before final export.

threeSecondReadOrder: るるぶ + WEDDING cover title system

pageSpec.geometryRule: Use normalized geometry as authority; Figma pixel values are approximations. Direct reference comparison and relational constraints outrank exact pixels.

visualAuthority.firstImpression: Bright, high-energy Japanese travel-magazine wedding cover; playful, dense, layered, tropical and immediately magazine-like rather than a generic wedding brochure.
visualAuthority.signatureMove: An enormous pink WEDDING title occupies the upper third while the couple hero rises directly beneath it; a left vertical teaser stack, date-ticket ephemera, tropical/destination edge clusters and a bottom cloud story vessel create an authored cover silhouette.
visualAuthority.composition: Dominant title block across upper third, one large central/right couple hero photograph, a narrow asymmetric Feature 1/2/3 column on the left, postal/date objects at left-middle, destination art at upper-right/mid-right, and a separate bottom closing hook with postmark/page meta.
visualAuthority.antiCompressionRule: Do not summarize rings, flower clusters, route doodles, feature icons, postmarks and story micro accents into one generic sticker layer. Their different editorial jobs are part of the cover personality.

backgroundSystem.role: Establish bright travel-destination atmosphere behind all editorial objects and the hero.
backgroundSystem.description: Bright blue sky/cloud/resort field with church/palm destination cues concentrated mainly around the hero/right side. It must feel like a travel-cover environment, not a plain blue rectangle.
mustPreserve: clear negative pockets behind title and date/teaser objects

geometry.tolerance: ±2% first pass; tune by direct reference comparison

outerBorder.description: Thin repeating diagonal blue/pink/yellow/white airmail perimeter with white inner separation.
outerBorder.rule: Do not replace with a generic single-color stroke.

heroPhotoMask.visibleFrame: none/open editorial hero; do not add a white polaroid frame

geometry.tolerance: ±3% position / ±4% size; face safety may override TARGET crop

faceSafe.rule: Move/crop within TARGET before allowing title, date, teaser or postmark decoration to cross a face.

frameSystem.featureFrameRule: Each support photo uses an independent white printed-photo/postcard frame above a clipped replaceable image. The three modules may share editorial DNA but must not become one repeated rounded-card component.

objects.visualRule: Three chunky colored kana blocks with thick white/black dimensional outline. Display art, not ordinary native body text.
Extremely large hot-pink rounded lettering with white/yellow/dark dimensional outline and deep visual weight. Never reduce into small clean type.
Yellow cloud/burst-like outlined badge. The year is cover metadata; keep editable/QA-verified.
Energetic yellow ribbon with blue lower/back edge. Names remain editable factual text.
Do not simplify to a generic rectangle/date chip. Keep postal-paper irregularity and cancellation-line behavior.

objects.referenceHeading: ふたりのプロフィール

objects.referenceHeadingTruthStatus: VISUAL_REFERENCE_ONLY; final editorial wording must follow current content plan

objects.visualRule: This is a strong lower cover hook, not a generic footer card. Keep the separate bottom floral edge cluster behind/below it.
White/blue circular page badge with a separate small pink heart accent. Keep subordinate.

decorativeObjects.description: Two gold wedding rings with diamond plus yellow sparkle punctuation at the top-left; distinct from masthead lettering.
Green tropical leaves and white/yellow plumeria emerging behind/beside the masthead; not part of the kana glyph asset.
Pink dotted heart route plus blue airplane around/above the 2026 badge; decorative travel cue, not factual routing.
Large hibiscus + monstera + plumeria cluster anchoring the WEDDING/ribbon left edge.
Composite destination object: white chapel, sea/water cue, palm trees, tropical flowers and a small pink heart. Do not reduce to generic flowers only.
Low-saliency local accents around the left teaser stack, including route dots, small sparkles/flowers/leaves. Preserve authored irregularity but do not create a sticker field.
Yellow sparkles and pink heart punctuation around the bottom story vessel. Presence matters; exact micro placement may flex.
Large bottom-edge tropical flowers/foliage; separate from the story cloud and essential to the cover's lower-edge closure.

featureRoleLocks.sharedFamily: All three are yellow-numbered editorial teasers with native headings and independently replaceable framed thumbnails.
featureRoleLocks.rule: Do not normalize Feature 1/2/3 into identical cards, identical iconography or mechanically mirrored decoration.

quietZones.rule: No new sticker, feature label, postmark, flower or copy across either eye/face. Preserve both heads as the human focal center.
Keep 2026.10.24 fully readable; cancellation lines/flower may decorate edges but never cross essential digits.
Do not add filler stickers inside the central story copy area.
Feature-specific icons/route/flowers may touch local edges but must not reduce heading or thumbnail readability at A5.

saliency.rule: Never strengthen a micro decoration by weakening the cover title, hero, names/date or feature readability.

layerOrder.70-79: rings, tropical/destination art, 2026 backing, plane routes, micro accents, bottom flowers
layerOrder.rule: Preserve relationship order first; exact numeric z values may tune after overlay comparison.

hero.hardRule: Do not add a white printed-photo/polaroid frame to the hero just because support photos use one.

proposedGeneratedEditorialObjects: date ticket backing/postmark treatment without baked date digits
OUR JOURNEY postmark + cancellation line system
nativePrecisionObjects: simple micro sparkles/hearts when native recreation is visually faithful
assetDecompositionPlan.microAccentPolicy: Low-saliency sparkles/hearts/route dots must be recorded but need not each become a generated bitmap. Keep one-independent-editorial-object = one image; never pack unrelated accents into a sprite.

assetPaddingContract.rule: Figma placement must follow visible bounds, not unmeasured transparent padding.
